newsitem.title: USA: Blue-chip stocks extend losing streak to third day.
newsitem.headline: Blue-chip stocks extend losing streak to third day.

text.p: Blue-chip stocks closed lower for a third straight session Wednesday as investors worried whether stocks were heading for a big pre-election correction after sweeping to a series of record highs last week.

Based on early and unofficial data, the Dow Jones industrial average ended 25.34 points lower at 6,036.46 after being down nearly 70 points at one time. In the broader market, declining issues led advances 12-10 on active volume of 442 million shares on the New York Stock Exchange.
